default.description: Maintafox default capability set. Keep minimal. No additional permissions without ADR. File writes go only to paths the user picks in the native Save dialog (the dialog plugin grants that exact file at runtime) and to temporary print files; nothing else on disk is reachable from the webview.

mobile.description: Android field app. Core IPC only: no shell, no file system, no dialogs. The secure-store plugin is deliberately absent, so the webview can never read the database key or device secrets (only Rust calls it).
